verdict: Adjusting on all 12 covariates gives +0.091583 pp (pooled slope) and +0.100166 pp (Lin, per-arm slopes). The control-arm fit reaches R^2 = 0.1106 against 0.1056 for the single collapsed index, so the collapse costs 0.0050 of R^2 - which is why the CUPED stage can use one covariate without apology.
